## RE:volution Mod v1.2.6

v1.2.6 introduces the Paid Awakening Foundation and makes awakening costs server-authoritative while keeping rune upgrade as a separate, still-unimplemented mechanic.

### Added
- Added configurable paid awakening using the existing awakening resource, calculation type, cost, and payment configuration APIs.
- Added server-side affordability checks before awakening is applied.
- Added support for awakening price calculation modes `FIXED`, `BY_RANK`, and `FORMULA`, including global and per-status event multipliers.
- Added client synchronization for the active awakening payment resource and calculated price.
- Added awakening price rendering in the rune GUI.
- Added regression coverage for paid awakening and no-charge failure paths.
- Added an up-to-date v1.2.6 GUI screenshot showing paid awakening and the separate upgrade placeholder.

### Fixed
- Awakening payment is charged only after the progression decision allows the awakening.
- Invalid, blocked, incomplete, maximum-rank, or unaffordable awakening attempts do not spend resources.
- Rune upgrade UI no longer displays the awakening price.
- Awakening and rune upgrade are explicitly treated as separate mechanics in the GUI and documentation.
- The legacy `upgrade_rune:` network action remains compatible as the transport for awakening, but it does not mean that a separate rune upgrade mechanic exists.

### Other
- The current technical baseline for Poison awakening is 100 rune dust; this is not a finalized economy balance.
- Existing collection progression from v1.2.5 remains unchanged: the selected rune advances one rank, current collection-rank runes are consumed, and already higher-ranked runes are preserved.
- Advanced remains the maximum supported rune rank.
- Existing rune purchases and duplicate compensation remain unchanged.
- Manual runtime validation confirmed the paid awakening flow, resource deduction, GUI placement, and separation between awakening and upgrade.
- Feature, develop, and main CI validation completed successfully before release preparation.
- Updated the mod version metadata to `1.2.6`.

### Download
Use the attached `customguimod-1.2.6.jar` on both client and server.

Compatible resource pack: [RE:volution Resource Pack v1.1.0](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-resource-pack/releases/tag/v1.1.0), available in 64x64 and 128x128 variants.

**Full Changelog:** [v1.2.5...v1.2.6](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.2.5...v1.2.6)
